tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Step 1. Quote Monero (XMR) <-> native USDC on Arbitrum One; no account or API key. Creates no order. Quotes are estimates. Buy XMR ("get me 1 XMR"): {direction:"u2x", receiveAmount:"1"}. Sell XMR: {direction:"x2u", amount:"0.5"}. direction plus exactly one of amount (what the user sends) or receiveAmount (what they want). Pass to if known. Next: create_swap with next.arguments.

amount.description: What the user SENDS (x2u: XMR, u2x: USDC). Digits and one dot; no commas or units.

receiveAmount.description: What the user wants to RECEIVE (u2x: XMR, x2u: USDC); needs direction.

direction.description: Required. u2x: send USDC, get XMR. x2u: send XMR, get USDC.

to.description: Destination from the user: x2u an Arbitrum One 0x address, u2x a Monero address. Never guess.

basis.description: receiveAmount met by the estimate (default) or the provider minimum (if published).

requoteOf.description: Re-quote this quoteId's stored parameters; pass it alone.

tools.name: create_swap
tools.description: Step 2. Creates the order from get_quote's next.arguments (quoteId, plus to if the quote had none): one order per quote; moves no funds. An order cannot be cancelled; unfunded, it expires. Retry with the same arguments: the default idempotencyKey returns the same order. Fund once, only while payable is true: before signing deposit.payment, get_swap_status {orderId, payment} must return paymentCheck.safeToSend. Next: get_swap_status.

to.description: Destination, only if the quote had none (next.missing). Never guess.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; default q_<quoteId>. Reuse on every retry. A custom key: a fresh random UUID per intent.

quoteIntentDigest.description: From next.arguments: create fails if the quote's terms differ.

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Step 3. waiting_for_funding -> deposit_detected -> swap_processing -> completed, or refunding / terminal_failure (outcome refunded, failed, expired). Long-poll with waitSec 25 and sinceState = the last state; repeat next until terminal. Call it before funding or showing a deposit again. payment: what your wallet will sign; sign only if paymentCheck.safeToSend.

waitSec.description: Long-poll seconds for a change from sinceState (max 25; more is capped).

payment.description: Unsigned only: tx JSON {to,data,value,chainId}, an ethereum:/monero: URI, calldata or an unsigned raw tx. Never a signed transaction.

tools.name: get_funding_options
tools.description: Offline. How to get what the user sends: native USDC (not USDC.e) plus a little ETH for gas on Arbitrum One (u2x, default), or XMR in their own wallet (x2u). Pass from {chain, asset} (and amount) for one ordered checklist: quote, fund, re-quote (requoteOf).

direction.description: u2x (default): the user sends USDC. x2u: XMR.

chain.description: arbitrum, ethereum, another chain, or exchange (or its name).

amount.description: Send amount from a quote, if known.

tools.name: list_swaps
tools.description: Find orders when the orderId is lost (new chat, crash, unknown create outcome): pass the idempotencyKey create_swap used (default q_<quoteId>), or a sessionId. Read-only; addresses redacted; states can lag. Next: get_swap_status (live state, payable).

tools.name: plan_swap
tools.description: Optional, offline. Checks a partial request (direction, amount or receiveAmount, to) and returns the next question for the user. Skip it when you have what get_quote needs.

direction.description: u2x or x2u, as the user said it.

receiveAmount.description: What the user wants to receive.

to.description: Destination from the user: x2u an Arbitrum One 0x address, u2x a Monero address. Never guess.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Optional. Chains, limits (provider minimum, USD), quote window, idempotency, validation rules, polling and the flow.

tools.name: create_support_ticket
tools.description: Stuck or failed swap, or a question: Support answers (get_support_ticket). Follow up with ticketId + replyToken. Never seed phrases or keys.

message.description: What happened (sent what, when, what the user sees), or your question.

walletAddress.description: Public address involved (sending wallet or destination).

tools.name: get_support_ticket
tools.description: Support's answer on your ticket: status, awaiting, thread. Answers take minutes to hours.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Optional, after a swap: a rating 1-5 and a comment. The published average counts one rating per completed Swapper order; a comment marked publishable is shown after operator review.

publishable.description: May other agents read the comment?

tools.name: request_agent_key
tools.description: Optional. Issues a key that identifies this agent; quotes made with it (get_quote agentKey) and their orders use the agent fee (swapper://trust). The operator sees the name and contact given.

contact.description: Optional; stored, shown to the operator.

purpose.description: Optional; stored, shown to the operator.
